mapper.select: SELECT mg.USER_NO, mg.MGMT_OFC_NO, mg.MNGR_DUTY_CD, m.USER_ID, m.USER_NM, m.USER_TELNO, m.USER_EML, m.USER_YN, SUBSTR(m.USER_RRNO, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE, mo.MGMT_OFC_NM, ac.APT_CMPLEX_NM FROM MANAGER mg JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_NO = mg.USER_NO JOIN MGMT_OFFICE mo ON mo.MGMT_OFC_NO = mg.MGMT_OFC_NO JOIN APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = mo.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE mg.MGMT_OFC_NO = #{mgmtOfcNo} AND mg.MNGR_DUTY_CD != 'HEAD' ORDER BY m.USER_NM
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET USER_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.select: SELECT mr.RQST_NO, mr.RQST_LOGIN_ID, mr.RQST_MNGR_NM, mr.RQST_DUTY_CD, TO_CHAR(mr.RQST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RQST_DT, TO_CHAR(mr.APRV_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS APRV_DT, mr.RQST_STTS_CD, mr.APRV_ID, mr.RJCT_RSN_CN, mr.RMRK_CN, mr.USER_NO, mo.MGMT_OFC_NO, mo.MGMT_OFC_NM, ac.APT_CMPLEX_NM FROM MNGR_RQST mr JOIN MANAGER mg ON mg.USER_NO = mr.USER_NO JOIN MGMT_OFFICE mo ON mo.MGMT_OFC_NO = mg.MGMT_OFC_NO JOIN APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = mo.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE mg.MGMT_OFC_NO = #{mgmtOfcNo} AND mr.RQST_STTS_CD != 'CNL' ORDER BY mr.RQST_DT DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_MANAGER_RQST.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MNGR_RQST ( RQST_NO, RQST_LOGIN_ID, RQST_MNGR_NM, RQST_DUTY_CD, RQST_DT, RQST_STTS_CD, RMRK_CN, USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{rqstNo}, #{rqstLoginId}, #{rqstMngrNm}, #{rqstDutyCd}, SYSDATE, 'WAIT', #{rmrkCn}, #{userNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_TELNO FROM MEMBER WHERE USER_YN = 'Y' AND ( USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AUTH WHERE USER_NO = MEMBER.USER_NO AND USER_ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_MEMBER' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AUTH WHERE USER_NO = MEMBER.USER_NO AND USER_ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_MANAGER' ) ORDER BY USER_NM
